correctness.rationale: F=Q(X^3,Y^3,Z^3), whose partial derivatives are 3X^2,3Y^2,3Z^2 times the respective linear expressions in X^3,Y^3,Z^3. On torus, singularity iff det [[2,c,a],[c,2,b],[a,b,2]]=2Delta vanishes; on coordinate sides iff b^2=4 etc. Coordinate vertices are excluded by F(vertex)=1. The invariant field is generated by cube ratios, so degree9 quotient by C3^2. Six conic side intersections are simple for smooth locus, all inertia3; genus10 and Riemann-Hurwitz 18=-18+36. Generic b=2 has local equation 9s^2+(a-c)X^3+ higher, giving 3 A2 singularities if Delta=-(a-c)^2!=0. Generic Delta=0 rank2 conic splits into distinct lines away from sides; their cube pullbacks are smooth diagonal cubics and meet transversely in 9 etale preimages. Independent symbolic differentiation/determinant/factorization checked.
